<!-- pr-reviewer: bb5ecc43b0c339ed4ba9e4947f316616b5113448 -->
**Verdict: blockers (process law), the tree itself is clean.**

Blockers: open P1 and P2 issues. AGENTS.md says a minor/major cut does not start while any P1 or P2 is open.
- P1 #1417: xtask unit test `no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app` fails on main (gate maps name moved modules as `app::`). In review. Worth checking why the release gate's xtask lane did not catch it, or whether it landed after the gate run.
- P2 #1398: fanuc-lathe live-tool feed cap measures unrounded coordinates, posted X/Z can run about 7% over fmax (follow-up to PR 1395). In review.
Either fix and merge (then the cut needs a re-merge of main and a re-gate) or the maintainer decides explicitly to override.

Checked (read-only, git and gh only):
1. Head is still bb5ecc43b; PR is MERGEABLE.
2. Diff vs main holds only: CHANGELOG.md, Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, RECOMMENDED.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md, exactly three PNGs (egui_app, egui_app_light, egui_tool_editor), and deletions of docs/decisions/*.md (186 files in docs; README kept). No change under crates/*/src, xtask/, assets/. Cargo.lock holds only 0.18.0 to 0.19.0 version lines.
3. No stray files (tmp, *.new.png, *.diff.png, gate-logs, dist, target).
4. RECOMMENDED.md has one `## v0.19.0` heading. RELEASE_NOTES.md starts with 0.19.0, Breaking first, has "Process changes" and "Known issues", and 0.18.0 and earlier history follows (1254 lines vs 1072 on main, not truncated).
5. CHANGELOG: 180 new rows, all version 0.19.0; one "Unreleased" occurrence remains in the file (pre-existing text, not a row version of the new rows; worth a glance by the author). Spot-checked rows for PRs 1406, 1061, 961, 1179, 999: all MERGED, merge commits match the row hashes.
6. Workspace version 0.19.0 in root Cargo.toml; all crates and xtask use `version.workspace = true`, same as v0.18.0.
7. PR body: no closing keywords, no @mentions.

Not done: not built, no tests run. The release gate (14 lanes ok) is taken from the release agent's report, not re-verified. Only five CHANGELOG rows and no snapshot visuals were inspected.

Maintainer decision (2026-11-13, question dialog): "Tag now as it is". The cut goes ahead on the tree that passed the release gate, with two issues open and named as known issues of 0.19.0:

- issue 1417 (P1): the xtask unit test `no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app` is red on main (ten gate-map headers name moved modules). Tooling only; PR 1421 merges after the tag.
- issue 1398 (P2): Fanuc lathe live-tool feed cap is measured on unrounded coordinates; posted X/Z can run about 7 % over the machine's maximum feed. PR 1397 merges after the tag.
